info.description: Multi-tenant school, family, learning and tutoring platform API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable `code`.
info.title: School API

post.summary: Sign in a student with the QR token or text code their teacher printed (case and hyphen are ignored); every failure is the same 400 auth.invalid_code
Sign out this device: revokes the refresh token's session
Sign out everywhere: revokes every session of the signed-in user
Send a one-time sign-in code to a phone (SMS) or email; the answer is the same whether or not an account exists
Exchange a one-time code for tokens
Sign in with email, phone or username and a password
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair; the old refresh token stops working

Accept a live invitation with the one-time code: finds or creates the adult's account, links them to the child (PENDING until the school verifies, unless the school auto-verifies its own SMS/email invites accepted from the invited destination) and signs them in. Wrong or expired codes are 400 auth.invalid_code

Send a one-time code to the phone or email of the adult accepting a live invitation (even when no account exists; 3 per destination and 20 per address per hour). 404 invitation.not_found for unknown, expired, revoked or used-up invitations

What a live invitation is about, before signing in: school, the child's first name, relationship, channel. Unknown, expired, revoked and used-up invitations are all 404 invitation.not_found; guessing is rate limited (429)

get.summary: The signed-in user, their roles and permissions per scope

patch.summary: Change display name, preferred language, timezone or calendar; absent fields stay unchanged

delete.summary: Remove my avatar and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY AVATAR upload of mine as my avatar (the previous file is deleted)

get.summary: My children through ACTIVE links that are not custody-restricted (record, schools, classes and teachers when the link allows academics); PENDING requests listed apart with the child's first name only
The caller's classes as student or teacher across schools, with school and the caller's role (at most 200, active only unless includeArchived)

For each child I may give consent for (ACTIVE link, not restricted, can_give_consent) and school: ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION and MEDIA_PUBLICATION with the current text, my latest decision and whether a new decision is needed; plus my own TERMS and PRIVACY

post.summary: Record a decision on the current policy version: for a child (studentId; schoolId when the child is in several schools) ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION or MEDIA_PUBLICATION, or for myself (no studentId) TERMS or PRIVACY. 404 consent.child_not_found for children I may not decide for, 409 consent.version_outdated for any version but the current one

get.summary: The home feed of a guardian (or student): posts of the classes their children are ACTIVE in and school-wide posts of those children's schools, newest first, across schools. studentId narrows it to one child (404 student.not_found when it is not the caller's child). Children behind a revoked, pending or custody-restricted link, or without can_view_academics, contribute nothing; photos withheld for consent are left out

post.summary: Redeem an invitation link token or printed parent code as the signed-in adult (STANDARD account with a verified phone or email, which is the proof). Creates a PENDING link (or returns the existing one); unknown, expired or used-up invitations are 404 invitation.not_found

get.summary: Every notification type by category with its channels: enabled (stored choice, else the type's default) and locked (the user cannot change it)

put.summary: Switch PUSH on or off per type; locked types and IN_APP cannot be switched off (400 notification.preference_locked)

get.summary: Quiet hours (in my timezone) and digest mode

put.summary: Set quiet hours (both times or neither); only digest mode OFF exists so far
Set or change the password; other sessions are signed out. A first password needs a recent sign-in

post.summary: Register (or refresh) this device's push token for my current session; a token already registered to someone else moves to me

delete.summary: Stop pushes to one of my devices (idempotent)

get.summary: Active stories of the classes and schools of the caller's children (or of the caller, a student), newest first; studentId narrows it to one child
The purposes that accept uploads, with allowed types and size limits

post.summary: Start an upload: validates purpose, type and size, and returns a presigned PUT URL (10 minutes)

delete.summary: Delete a media file (uploader or manager of its context)

get.summary: Status and metadata of a media file

post.summary: Verify the uploaded object (size, type, magic bytes) and queue processing

get.summary: A signed GET link (5 minutes) for a variant; images need THUMB, SMALL or MEDIUM
Service metadata and server time
My notifications, newest first (archived ones excluded)

post.summary: Mark every unread notification read
Send myself a test notification (platform administrators): inbox, real-time and push

get.summary: How many unread notifications I have

post.summary: Remove a notification from the inbox (idempotent)
Mark one notification read (idempotent)

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first; filter by action prefix, actor, target, school and time range
Every feature and setting definition (key, schema, default, allowed scopes), for override editors

delete.summary: Remove a feature override so the next level applies

get.summary: Feature overrides at exactly one scope

put.summary: Enable or disable a feature at a scope

get.summary: List organizations the caller may manage, newest first

post.summary: Create an organization in an enabled country

get.summary: Get an organization

put.summary: Update name, legal name and status (the slug is fixed)

delete.summary: Remove the organization's logo and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this organization as its logo (the previous file is deleted)

get.summary: The plans a school can be given, with localized names
Role assignments of a user, or at exactly one scope; only those the caller may manage

post.summary: Grant a role to a user at a scope (at or below the caller's own scope, never more than the caller holds)

delete.summary: Revoke a role assignment (it stays listed as REVOKED)

get.summary: List the schools the caller can see, newest first, filtered by country, organization, status

post.summary: Create a school (ONBOARDING) in an enabled country; unset fields inherit the country's defaults

get.summary: Get a school
List a school's campuses

post.summary: Add a campus to a school

put.summary: Update a campus

get.summary: A school's effective features and settings, with the level each value comes from

delete.summary: Remove the school's cover image and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this school as its cover image

delete.summary: Remove the school's logo and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this school as its logo (the previous file is deleted)
Change a school's status
Manually assign a plan to a school, ending its current subscription

delete.summary: Remove a setting override so the next level applies

get.summary: Setting overrides at exactly one scope, optionally one key

put.summary: Set a setting at a scope; the value is validated against the definition's schema

post.summary: Create an ACTIVE user whose phone or email is marked verified (the administrator vouches for it)

get.summary: Find a user by an exact phone or email (no listing or search); 404 when there is none
A user's display name and masked destination, by id

The current text of a policy (public): the school's own document if it has a published version, else the country default (country, default ET); in lang, else English, else any language. 404 policy.not_found

post.summary: A single-use ticket (60 seconds) to open the WebSocket at /ws from a browser, sent as the STOMP CONNECT header 'ticket'

get.summary: Enabled countries with languages, calendars, currency, address and name formats
Administrative areas of a country (region, zone, woreda ...), by level and parent
Enabled languages
A school's id, name and status from its slug; 404 when unknown or when the caller cannot read it

post.summary: A lead, co or subject teacher of the student's class (or an attendance manager) acknowledges a SUBMITTED report: the roll shows it for those dates and markAllPresent pre-fills EXCUSED. Audited. 409 absence.already_decided
The guardian who filed a SUBMITTED or ACKNOWLEDGED report withdraws it
Declines a SUBMITTED report (same people as acknowledge), with an optional note for the record. Audited. 409 absence.already_decided

get.summary: The school's academic years, newest first (a short list, no paging)

post.summary: Create an academic year (PLANNED unless stated); makeCurrent also makes it the school's current year

delete.summary: Delete a year with its periods; 409 when it is current or classes use it

get.summary: One academic year

patch.summary: Change name, dates or status (absent fields stay); 409 when the new dates cut off a period or the current year would be closed

post.summary: Make this the school's only current year (the previous current year stays as it is; a CLOSED year cannot be current)

get.summary: The year's periods in sequence order

post.summary: Add a period: within the year, no overlap with other periods (409 academic.period_overlap), unique sequence (defaults to the next)

delete.summary: Delete a period

patch.summary: Change a period (same rules as creating one)

get.summary: The templates the caller may use: their own, those shared with a class they teach and the school-wide ones, newest first. Teachers and points managers; filters classId, templateType, mine

post.summary: Save a routine, checklist or activity (visibility PRIVATE by default; CLASS needs classId of a class the caller teaches; SCHOOL shares it with every teacher)

delete.summary: Delete a template; its owner or a points manager

get.summary: One template (404 when the caller may not see it)

patch.summary: Change a template (absent fields stay; items replace the list); its owner or a points manager

get.summary: The daily dashboard: per class (keyset paged by name) whether the roll was taken for the date and slot, students, marked, unmarked and the counts per status, plus school totals including the classes that have not taken attendance. school.attendance.read/manage see every class, teachers the classes they teach; students and guardians get 403

Marks counted per student and class over from..to (school-local dates, inclusive, default the last 30 days, at most 400), keyset paged in student name order. With classId: teachers of that class and school.attendance.read/manage; without: school.attendance.read/manage (studentId narrows to one student). Teachers' notes and absence reports are not part of it

The same report as a CSV download: UTF-8 with a byte order mark, CRLF line ends, headers in the caller's language, spreadsheet formulas neutralized, sorted by student name. Audited, rate limited (10 per 10 minutes, 429 attendance.export_rate_limited), at most 50000 rows
The school's badges (its copies of the default set and its own), in the caller's language; managers can include inactive ones. School members only

post.summary: Define a badge (school.points.manage). criteria by type: POINTS_TOTAL {threshold, context?}, CATEGORY_TOTAL {threshold, categoryId or templateCode}, ATTENDANCE_STREAK {days} (granted by attendance, M7), MANUAL (none)

patch.summary: Rename, change the rule's parameters or (de)activate a badge (school.points.manage); badges already granted stay

get.summary: Classes the caller may see (students and teachers: their own; administrators: all in scope), by name; filters year, grade, campus, status, type, mine, q

post.summary: Create a class: needs class.manage, or be a teacher of the school while classes.teachers_can_create is on (the teacher becomes lead)

delete.summary: Delete a class that never had students (and no teacher besides its first lead); otherwise 409 class.not_empty, archive it instead

get.summary: One class the caller may see; 404 otherwise

patch.summary: Change a class (lead teacher or class.manage; campus and year only with class.manage); subjectIds replaces the set

get.summary: Absence reports of the students ACTIVE in the class touching from..to (default a week back to 60 days ahead), SUBMITTED and ACKNOWLEDGED unless status says otherwise, oldest first, keyset paged. Reason and note only for the lead, co and subject teachers and attendance managers. Teachers of the class, class managers, school.attendance.read/manage

post.summary: Archive a class: it stays readable and keeps its members, but its roster can no longer change

get.summary: The roll of a class for a school-local date (default today) and slot (default the school's first): every student who belonged to the class that day with their record, suggestedStatus (EXCUSED for an acknowledged absence report) and the absence-report annotation (reason and note only for the lead, co and subject teachers and attendance managers). ACTIVE teachers of the class, class managers and school.attendance.read/manage (403 for students and guardians who see the class, 404 for everybody else)

put.summary: Takes or corrects a roll: records are upserted (students left out stay as they are, unmarked stay unmarked), markAllPresent marks every student without a record present (EXCUSED when an acknowledged absence report covers the date). A mark that differs from the stored record is written only when it carries the record's current version (expectedVersion) or the roll's baseVersion is current; otherwise it is a CONFLICT and nothing is overwritten. 200 with per-student outcomes; 409 with the same body when some marks conflicted (the others were written). Refused before writing anything: date in the future (409 attendance.date_in_future), student not in the class that day (409 attendance.student_not_in_class), slot not enabled, locked roll without the right or the reason (409 attendance.session_locked, 400 attendance.override_reason_required), archived class (409 class.archived). Teachers of the class (assistants while the school allows it), class managers, school.attendance.manage

get.summary: The roster's consent column (teachers of the class, class managers, school.guardians.manage): per ACTIVE student the effective ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION and MEDIA_PUBLICATION status, without guardian identities. Treat MEDIA_PUBLICATION UNKNOWN as not allowed

post.summary: A guardian (about a child ACTIVE in the class; link with can_view_academics and can_message_staff) or a student of the class contributes text and photos. Needs feed.parent_contributions.enabled or feed.student_contributions.enabled (403 feed.contributions_disabled). Waits for approval (PENDING_APPROVAL) unless the school switched approval off for guardians (then a photo must tag the contributor's own child and passes the consent gate); student contributions are always approved first. A guardian tags only their own children, a student nobody

get.summary: The published posts of a class, pinned first then newest first. Teachers and managers of the class, its ACTIVE students and guardians of ACTIVE students (not custody-restricted, with can_view_academics); 404 class.not_found for everybody else, 403 feed.feature_disabled when the school switched the feed off

post.summary: Save a whole group set (one run of the group maker) at once: all groups are created or none. 409 class.group_member_not_in_class when a member is not an ACTIVE student of the class

get.summary: Saved student groups of the class (teachers of the class)

post.summary: Save a group of the class's students (a result of the group maker)

delete.summary: Delete a saved group

patch.summary: Rename a saved group and/or replace its members (absent fields stay)

get.summary: Top positive class totals (at most 10, ties share a rank). 403 points.leaderboard_disabled unless the school turned engagement.leaderboard.enabled on (default off); members of the class roster only, never guardians

post.summary: Issue new login codes for students of the class (default: all ACTIVE students); their previous live codes are revoked. The plaintext codes are in this response only, with Cache-Control: no-store

delete.summary: Revoke one login code of the class's sheet

post.summary: Print parent codes (home connection) for students of the class (default: all ACTIVE students): one code per student for up to guardians.parent_code.max_uses adults within guardians.parent_code.ttl_days; the student's previous live code is revoked. Links made with a code are always PENDING. The codes are in this response only (Cache-Control: no-store); do not send an Idempotency-Key
Add a category used in this class only (the class's LEAD or CO_TEACHER, class managers, points managers). 409 points.category_limit beyond 40 active ones

patch.summary: Change or (de)activate one of the class's own categories (who may add them)

get.summary: The class overview: every ACTIVE student with their class total (from the balance projection), plus the class settings the award screen needs. ACTIVE teachers of the class and class managers only (403 for students and guardians who see the class, 404 otherwise)

post.summary: Award points to one student, several (studentIds) or the whole class (wholeClass: true) in a category of the school or of the class. Teachers of the class (ACTIVE) and class managers; the students must be ACTIVE in the class; NEEDS_WORK categories only while the school allows them. Several students share one batchId. 201 new, 200 replay of a clientOpId

Create a class post (draft, publish now or schedule). ACTIVE teachers of the class (assistants while feed.assistants_can_post) and class managers. Media uploaded as POST media of the class; tagged students must be ACTIVE in the class. With media: every tagged student needs MEDIA_PUBLICATION consent (else 422 feed.media_consent_missing); with no tags confirmNoUnconsentedStudents must be true (else 422 feed.media_confirmation_required)
Make an archived class active again

get.summary: The active (not expired) stories of a class, newest first, to those who may see the class feed

post.summary: Publish a class story (teachers of the class and class managers): a STORY photo uploaded for the class and/or a caption. Same consent gate as posts

get.summary: The class's ACTIVE students by name (at most 500, no paging). Date of birth, gender and username only for teachers of the class and school.students.manage (accessLevel FULL); everybody else gets name and avatar

post.summary: Add students of the school to the class (all or none; 409 when one is not enrolled or already a member)

delete.summary: End a student's membership (history is kept); reason REMOVED (default) or PROMOTED

post.summary: Move a student to another class of the school: ends this membership (TRANSFERRED_CLASS) and starts the new one, atomically

get.summary: The class's ACTIVE teachers: lead first

post.summary: Add a teacher of the school (lead teacher or class.manage); SUBJECT_TEACHER needs subjectId

delete.summary: Remove a teacher row (lead or class.manage; any non-lead teacher may remove herself); the last lead cannot be removed (409 class.last_lead)

get.summary: The approval queue, oldest first: contributions waiting in the classes the caller moderates (LEAD teacher, class managers, school feed managers). With classId only that class; 403 for everybody else who sees the school

post.summary: Approve and publish a pending contribution (moderators). Runs the consent gate: 422 feed.media_consent_missing, or 422 feed.media_confirmation_required when no student is tagged (confirmNoUnconsentedStudents is the approver's statement). studentIds, when given, replaces the tags. Audited; the contributor is notified. 409 feed.not_pending when already decided
Reject a pending contribution with a reason the contributor sees (moderators). The photos are deleted. Audited; the contributor is notified

get.summary: The published school-wide posts, pinned first then newest first. ACTIVE students, staff and guardians of ACTIVE students of the school, and school feed managers; 404 school.not_found for everybody else
What the caller may do in the feed of the school, or of one class when classId is given (for menus and buttons; the API stays the authority)
The school's grade levels in sequence order

post.summary: Add a grade level (sequence defaults to the next; unique per school)

delete.summary: Delete a grade level; 409 when classes use it (deactivate it instead)

patch.summary: Change a grade level, or deactivate it

post.summary: Revoke an invitation or a printed parent code; links already made stay as they are

get.summary: The verification queue: links of the school's ACTIVE students in one status (default PENDING), oldest first. Administrators see all, verifying lead teachers the students of their classes

patch.summary: Change a PENDING or ACTIVE link: permission flags, relationship, primary guardian (one per child), custody restriction with an admin-only note (a restricted link grants nothing)

post.summary: Verify a PENDING link (SCHOOL_VERIFIED): it becomes ACTIVE and the guardian is notified. 409 guardian_link.not_pending otherwise
Reject a PENDING link; the adult is notified
End a link: access stops with the guardian's next request

get.summary: Import history, newest first; filters status and importType

post.summary: Start an import from an uploaded file (media purpose IMPORT_FILE, READY): reads the header and the first rows, detects encoding and delimiter, suggests the column mapping

get.summary: Saved column mappings, optionally of one import type

post.summary: Save a column mapping (field key to header text) for an import type; 409 import.profile_name_taken

delete.summary: Delete a profile (imports that used it keep their mapping)

put.summary: Rename a profile or replace its mapping

get.summary: A template for the import type: header row of machine keys, an example row starting with # (ignored), instructions in English and Amharic (xlsx also has lists of the school's classes, grade levels and campuses)
The kinds of file that can be imported, with their columns (labels in the reader's language) and required fields

delete.summary: Delete an import with its rows and uploaded file at once (409 while it runs)

get.summary: One import: status, progress (poll while VALIDATING or COMMITTING), row counts, commit result, failure

post.summary: Cancel an import that was not committed yet; its rows are purged at once

Apply a VALIDATED import in the background: needs no unresolved duplicates, an unchanged file and mapping since the dry run, and no invalid rows unless skipInvalidRows. Poll until COMPLETED. After a FAILED commit the same call resumes
Check every row in the background (nothing is written to the school); poll the import until VALIDATED or FAILED. Allowed again after a change of mapping or a failure

get.summary: CSV of every problem: the file's columns plus row_number, severity, field, message (UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, formula-safe cells). Not cached

put.summary: Save the column mapping (field key to column index) and reading options; the file is read again with them and the job is PREVIEWED. 400 import.mapping_incomplete lists what is missing. Optionally saves the mapping as a profile

get.summary: The preview again (headers, first rows, mapping so far), for reloading the mapping step. When any of encoding, delimiter or sheet is given (an empty value means detect), the file is read that way instead and the mapping is suggested from the new headers; nothing is saved until the mapping is
The checked rows in file order (keyset by row number); filter status VALID, INVALID, DUPLICATE or SKIPPED. Errors and warnings are in the reader's language

post.summary: Decide a possible duplicate: LINK to an existing student (studentId), CREATE_NEW or SKIP. SKIP is also allowed for any row that was not applied yet

get.summary: The caller's own posts and contributions in the school in every status (drafts, scheduled, pending approval, rejected, published, archived), newest first

The skills a teacher can award: the school's active CLASS categories plus, with classId, that class's own (teachers of the class); without classId for any teacher or points manager (managers also see HOME categories). NEEDS_WORK categories are left out while the school switched them off, unless an editor asks with includeInactive

post.summary: Add a school-level category (school.points.manage). context HOME makes a category for guardians (POSITIVE only)

patch.summary: Rename, recolor, reorder, change default points or (de)activate a school-level category (school.points.manage). Never deleted: the ledger refers to it

post.summary: Award points school-wide (SCHOOL context, school-level categories) to ACTIVE students of the school (school.points.manage)
Undo a whole multi-student or whole-class award (every row not reversed yet), with the same rules as reversing one transaction

get.summary: Net points per student and category for CLASS and SCHOOL points (home points are never included), over from..to (school-local dates, inclusive), keyset paged in student then category id order. With classId: teachers of that class and school.points.read; without: school.points.read

The same report as a CSV download: UTF-8 with a byte order mark, CRLF line ends, headers in the caller's language, spreadsheet formulas neutralized, sorted by student name. Audited, rate limited (10 per 10 minutes, 429 points.export_rate_limited), at most 50000 rows

post.summary: Undo one award with a REVERSAL row. The awarder within the undo window (engagement.points.undo_window_seconds, default 120), the class's lead teacher, class managers and points managers any time; home points only by the guardian who awarded them, inside the window. 409 points.already_reversed, 403 points.undo_window_expired

get.summary: The school's own policy documents with every version (drafts included)

post.summary: Start the school's own wording of ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION or MEDIA_PUBLICATION (409 policy.already_exists); it replaces the country default once a version is published

put.summary: Rename a school policy document

post.summary: Add a draft version in one language (one row per label and language; 409 policy.version_exists)

put.summary: Change a draft version (409 policy.version_published once published)

post.summary: Publish a draft: it becomes immutable and takes effect at effectiveFrom (now at the earliest). With requiresReconsent, guardians are asked again and earlier grants stop counting once it is in effect
Create a school-wide post (school.feed.manage). Media uploaded as POST media of the school; tagged students must be ACTIVE in the school. Same consent gate as class posts

delete.summary: Delete a post (soft delete; its photos are deleted). The author, or a moderator (audited as moderation)

get.summary: One post. Published posts to those who may see them; any status to its author and the moderators (LEAD teacher, class managers, school feed managers). 404 for everybody else

patch.summary: Edit your own post (null fields stay; media and studentIds replace the whole list; an empty body clears the text). Sets editedAt. Editing the photos or tags of a published post runs the consent gate again; a contribution can be edited only while pending

post.summary: Take a published post down (ARCHIVED); the author or a moderator. It can be published again

get.summary: Comments of a post, oldest first. VISIBLE ones to everybody who sees the post; HIDDEN ones also to their author and the moderators. Authors are named only as the privacy rules allow (guardians and students otherwise appear by role label)

post.summary: Comment on a published post as yourself. Needs comments switched on for the post (403 feed.comments_disabled) and your relation to allow it: teachers and managers; guardians (link with can_view_academics and can_message_staff) while feed.comments.guardians_can_comment; students while feed.comments.students_can_comment (403 feed.comment_not_allowed)

delete.summary: Delete a comment: its author, or a moderator (audited)

post.summary: A moderator hides a comment (it stays visible to its author and moderators with status HIDDEN; audited)
See translation of a visible comment (same rules as translatePost)
A moderator shows a hidden comment again (audited)
A moderator hides a published post (audited); the optional reason is shown to its author as rejectionReason

delete.summary: Unpin a post (idempotent)

put.summary: Pin a published post (its teacher author or a moderator). At most feed.pin_limit (default 3) pinned posts per class or for the school feed: 409 feed.pin_limit_reached

post.summary: Publish a draft, scheduled or archived post now (author or moderator). Consent gate: 422 feed.media_consent_missing / feed.media_confirmation_required

delete.summary: Remove your reaction (idempotent)

put.summary: Set your one reaction to a published post you can see (replaces the previous one; repeating it changes nothing)

post.summary: Report a post you can see. A stub for the moderation queue of M13: it is audited and published as a ContentReported event; at most 20 reports a day

Schedule a draft (or change the time of a scheduled post), at most 90 days ahead; the consent gate runs now and again when the scheduler publishes (a blocked post returns to DRAFT with publishErrorCode and its author is notified)

See translation of a published post (decision D5): the cached machine translation, or one made through the provider adapter. 403 feed.translation_disabled unless the school switched feed.translation.enabled on (off by default), 503 feed.translation_unavailable without a provider. Only the post text leaves the platform, with tagged students' names masked. Always machineTranslated: true
A moderator shows a hidden post again (consent gate runs)
Cancel the schedule: the post becomes a draft again (author)
Record that the caller saw the post (once per viewer). Only a count is ever returned (seenCount), to the author and the class's staff; names are never exposed

get.summary: Staff by name; filters staffType, status, campusId, q. Managers see every status and masked contacts, other staff only ACTIVE colleagues

post.summary: Add a person to the school's staff by phone or email: finds their account or creates one the administrator vouches for; 409 staff.already_member when they are staff already

get.summary: One staff member

patch.summary: Change job title, campus or employee number (absent fields stay)

post.summary: Mark the staff member FORMER (ended today) and end their class teaching; administrative roles are not touched

get.summary: The active school stories, newest first, to the members and guardians of the school

post.summary: Publish a school story (school.feed.manage). Same consent gate as posts

delete.summary: Delete a story and its photo (the author, or a moderator; audited)

get.summary: One story: while active to those who may see it; to its author and moderators until it is deleted

post.summary: Record that the caller saw the story (once per viewer; only the count is ever shown, to the author and staff)

get.summary: Students by name (ACTIVE unless status is given); filters classId, gradeLevelId, campusId, status, q. School.students.manage sees all, teachers the students of their classes

post.summary: Create a school-managed student (no phone or email) and enroll them; optionally straight into a class. Needs school.students.manage, or be a teacher of that class

get.summary: One student: FULL for managers, the student and their teachers; BASIC (name, avatar) for classmates and class administrators; 404 for everybody else

patch.summary: Change a student's details (school.students.manage); the student themself may change only avatarConfig

get.summary: The absence reports of a student, newest first, keyset paged: a guardian sees the ones they filed (with reason and note); the student's lead, co and subject teachers and school.attendance.manage see all (with reason and note). 403 for other teachers and attendance readers, 404 for everybody else

post.summary: A guardian (ACTIVE, not custody-restricted link) reports that the child will be away from..to (school-local dates, at most 7 days back, 90 ahead, 61 long) for ILLNESS, FAMILY, APPOINTMENT or OTHER, with an optional note (health related: never shown to the child, other guardians or assistants, never in notifications). The student's teachers are notified without the reason. 404 for anybody who is not the child's guardian; at most 20 a day (429)

get.summary: A student's attendance history, newest first, keyset paged, optionally by class and school-local date range. The student and their ACTIVE guardians with can_view_academics see status, lateness, date and class (no teacher note); teachers see the classes they teach (with notes); school.attendance.read sees everything. 403 for others who can see the student, 404 for the rest

post.summary: Hand a MANUAL badge to a student: their teachers and points managers. Repeating it returns the existing award; the student and their guardians are notified once. 409 points.badge_not_manual, points.badges_disabled

get.summary: The child's effective statuses and every consent record, newest first (school.guardians.manage)

post.summary: Record a decision the school received on paper or verbally (school.guardians.manage): from a guardian link that may give consent (409 consent.guardian_not_eligible otherwise) or from a named guardian without an account

get.summary: The student's guardian invitations, newest first (destinations masked; never tokens or codes)

post.summary: Invite an adult by SMS or email to link to the student (single use, 14 days, sent in the school's language). The phone or email is not proof of guardianship: accepting creates a PENDING link. At most 10 live invitations per student (409 invitation.limit_reached)

get.summary: The student's guardian links. Administrators (school.guardians.manage) see every status with masked contact details and notes; teachers of the student see PENDING and ACTIVE links with names, relationship and status only

post.summary: Link an adult the school knows (the administrator vouches): found by phone or email or created, the link is ACTIVE (SCHOOL_VERIFIED)

get.summary: The HOME categories a guardian may award to their own child: an ACTIVE, not custody-restricted link with can_award_points (404 for anybody else linked to nothing, 403 without the flag)

post.summary: A guardian awards home points to their own child (HOME context, HOME category, never counted in class or school totals). Needs an ACTIVE, not custody-restricted link with can_award_points; at most 60 a day. 201 new, 200 replay of a clientOpId

get.summary: Metadata of the student's live login codes (never the codes); managers and teachers of the student

post.summary: Revoke every live login code of the student
Set an initial password (the student must change it); only while the school allows password sign-in (409 student.password_login_disabled) and the student has a username

get.summary: A student's totals by category and the badges earned: the school section (CLASS and SCHOOL points) and, for the student and their ACTIVE guardians only, a separate home section that is never added into class or school totals. Callers: the student, their guardians with can_view_academics, teachers (the classes they teach), school.points.read. academicYearId defaults to the school's current year

The points timeline of one section (SCHOOL or HOME), newest first, keyset paged; HOME only for the student and their guardians (403 otherwise). Reversals are rows of their own and awards that were undone say so

post.summary: Withdraw a student from the school: class memberships end, login codes are revoked, history stays

get.summary: The school's subjects by name

post.summary: Add a subject (code unique per school, case-insensitive)

delete.summary: Delete a subject; 409 when classes use it (deactivate it instead)

patch.summary: Change a subject, or deactivate it

get.summary: Counts of active students, teachers and classes plus what is already set up (current year, grade levels, subjects); needs school.read

post.summary: Applies a batch of operations queued by a device (at most 100, 1 MiB; ATTENDANCE_MARK, POINT_AWARD) in order and returns one result per operation, in the same order: APPLIED, DUPLICATE (the operation was seen before: the first outcome is returned, so replaying a whole batch is safe), CONFLICT (the data changed under the client: nothing was overwritten, state says what is there) or REJECTED (cannot succeed as sent: problem.code says why, do not resend). A failing operation never fails the batch or blocks the next one. Always 200 when the request itself is well formed (400 malformed, 413 too large, 429 rate limited). Operations are authorized exactly like their online endpoints, when applied
